plans.name: Settle by the stream
plans.goal: Build a reliable home base with renewable food, a bed, and a small lit house.
plans.why: I need a safe place and food before deeper machine work.

steps.text: Harvest my ripe wheat and replant; expand my stream-side field toward 20 crops.
steps.note: My saved crop now looks mature; harvest only my tile and replant it.

steps.text: Find a renewable food source I can use without disturbing Gary's garden.
Gather wool and planks, craft a bed, and save its place.
Build a small lit house with a door and chest on open land.
Check that food, bed, and house are all established; update my notes.
